references.text: The kings of the earth rise up, and the rulers take counsel together against the Lord and against his Anointed
But they plotted against him to take his life
Then the Pharisees went out and plotted how they might kill Jesus
But they were filled with rage and began to discuss among themselves what they could do to Jesus
So they watched him closely and sent spies who pretended to be righteous, in order to catch him in something he said, so that they might hand him over to the authorities and the power of the governor
